task_description: Fix the persistent PGRST205 'table not in schema cache' for jobs/job_applications/banners by piggybacking their data on already-cached tables: store Jobs as campaigns rows tagged is_job=true, Job Applications as applications rows pointing at those campaigns, and Banners as a JSON array in a platform_settings row (key='home_banners'). Rewrite jobs_provider.dart and banners_provider.dart to use those cached tables (no .from('jobs')/.from('job_applications')/.from('banners')), keeping all provider names/return shapes so screens are unchanged. Exclude is_job rows from the real Campaigns/Home lists. Ship an idempotent supabase/JOBS_VIA_CAMPAIGNS.sql the user runs. Revert the temporary DBG3 passthrough in error_utils.dart. Do not break campaigns, wallet, or notifications; no mock data.
